content.label: Social posting cadence
content.help: How many image posts and reels the social studio generates a day, and which weekdays it runs on (1 Monday … 7 Sunday). 0 posts and 0 reels with no weekdays, as it ships: nothing is generated until a number is set here.

voice.label: Brand voice
voice.help: A short line on the shop's tone, the hashtags added to every caption, and words the studio must never use. Empty as it ships.

captions.label: AI writes the hook and caption
captions.help: Off as it ships (AI stays off on the live site until you turn it on). While off, a post's caption comes from its template's own words with the product and price filled in, never from AI.
